title: The Cleanup Ladder
prompt: File-scope counters `int a_alive = 0, b_alive = 0, c_alive = 0;` are already in your editor. Implement `int cleanup_ladder(int fail_at)` simulating a three-resource acquisition: allocate A (a_alive++), then B (b_alive++), then C (c_alive++); if fail_at is 1, 2, or 3, simulate failure *before* that resource's allocation, releasing everything acquired so far in reverse order and returning -1; success returns 0 with everything released too. Every path must leave all counters at 0.

tests.name: fail at 1
tests.hint: Nothing beyond A was acquired; A itself is released on the way out.

tests.name: fail at 2
tests.hint: A and B acquired, both released, reverse order.

tests.name: success releases too
tests.hint: The success path is also a cleanup path.
